title: Reporting statements (3): say and tell; verb tense in the reporting clause
summary: Различие **say / tell**, их устойчивые сочетания и выбор времени вводного глагола (**said, says, has told, was telling, was told**).
ru:
## Say и tell: в чём разница
- **tell** всегда требует **человека** (адресата): *She told **me** (that) she was tired.* ~~She told that she was tired.~~
- **say** обходится без адресата: *She said (that) she was tired.* Если адресат назван, нужен **to**: *She said **to me** that she was tired* (чаще говорят *told me*).
> He **told** the staff that the office would close. — Он сообщил персоналу, что офис закроют.
> He **said** that the office would close. — Он сказал, что офис закроют.
**say** употребляют и с прямой речью, и со словами без that: *say hello, say sorry, say thanks, say a prayer, say something, say so*.

## Устойчивые сочетания
- **tell**: *tell the truth, tell a lie, tell a story, tell a joke, tell a secret, tell the time, tell the difference, tell someone's fortune.* ~~say the truth~~, ~~say a joke~~.
- **tell** = «отличать»: *I can't **tell** the twins **apart**.* · *Can you **tell** the original **from** the copy?*
- **tell off** (отчитать), **tell on** (донести): *The teacher **told** him **off**.*
- **say** для текстов, табличек, надписей: *The sign **says** "No entry". The label **says** to keep it refrigerated.* ~~The sign tells "No entry".~~ (с адресатом *tell* возможен: *The sign tells drivers to slow down*.)
- **tell** для распоряжений: *He **told** me to leave.* **say** в разговорной речи, особенно AmE: *He **said** to wait.*

## Время вводного глагола
Выбор времени вводного глагола (said / says / has told / was telling) зависит от того, **когда** и **зачем** вы сообщаете слова.
- **Past simple (said, told)** — слова были сказаны в прошлом; в придаточном обычно сдвиг: *She **told** me the report **was** ready.*
- **Present simple (says, tells)** — нейтрально для газет, текстов, инструкций и для того, что сказано и ещё актуально: *The forecast **says** it will rain.* · *He always **says** he'll call but never does.* Сдвига времён нет.
- **Present perfect (has said, has told)** — недавнее или важное сейчас: *He's **told** everyone I'm leaving.* — Он всем рассказал, что я ухожу (и это важно сейчас).
- **Past continuous (was saying / was telling)** — незавершённое или прерванное: *I **was just telling** Ruth about the plan when you came in.* Также смягчение: *I was wondering if...*
- **Future (will tell / will say)**: *I'll **tell** him you called.*
- **Пассив**: *I **was told** (that) the flight was delayed. We've **been told**...* Но ~~I was said~~.
- **Настоящее в рассказе (historical present)** — разговорно: *So he **says** to me, "Where's the money?"*
Идиома: *Well, she **would say** that, wouldn't she?* — Ну, она бы так и сказала! (т. е. её слова ожидаемы и не очень убедительны).

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She said me that she was late.~~ → She **told me** (that) she was late.
- ~~He told that he was ill.~~ → He **told us** that he was ill.
- ~~I was said that the train was cancelled.~~ → I **was told** that...
- ~~Don't say lies. / He said the truth.~~ → Don't **tell** lies. / He **told** the truth.
- ~~She told a few words.~~ → She **said** a few words.
- ~~The label tells to keep it cold.~~ → The label **says** to keep it cold.
en:
## Say and tell: the difference
- **tell** always needs a **person** (a listener): *She told **me** (that) she was tired.* ~~She told that she was tired.~~
- **say** does not need a listener: *She said (that) she was tired.* If the listener is named, we need **to**: *She said **to me** that she was tired* (more usually *told me*).
> He **told** the staff that the office would close.
> He **said** that the office would close.
**say** is also used with direct speech and fixed phrases: *say hello, say sorry, say thanks, say a prayer, say something, say so*.

## Fixed phrases
- **tell**: *tell the truth, tell a lie, tell a story, tell a joke, tell a secret, tell the time, tell the difference, tell someone's fortune.* ~~say the truth~~, ~~say a joke~~.
- **tell** = "distinguish": *I can't **tell** the twins **apart**.* · *Can you **tell** the original **from** the copy?*
- **tell off** (scold), **tell on** (inform against): *The teacher **told** him **off**.*
- **say** for texts and signs: *The sign **says** "No entry". The label **says** to keep it refrigerated.* ~~The sign tells "No entry".~~ (with a listener, *tell* is possible: *The sign tells drivers to slow down*.)
- **tell** for orders: *He **told** me to leave.* **say** is possible in informal speech, especially AmE: *He **said** to wait.*

## Tense of the reporting verb
The tense of the reporting verb (said / says / has told / was telling) depends on **when** and **why** you report the words.
- **Past simple (said, told)** — the words were spoken in the past; the that-clause usually shifts back: *She **told** me the report **was** ready.*
- **Present simple (says, tells)** — neutral for newspapers, texts and instructions, and for things that are still relevant: *The forecast **says** it will rain.* · *He always **says** he'll call but never does.* No backshift.
- **Present perfect (has said, has told)** — recent or currently important: *He's **told** everyone I'm leaving.*
- **Past continuous (was saying / was telling)** — unfinished or interrupted: *I **was just telling** Ruth about the plan when you came in.* Also softening: *I was wondering if...*
- **Future (will tell / will say)**: *I'll **tell** him you called.*
- **Passive**: *I **was told** (that) the flight was delayed. We've **been told**...* But ~~I was said~~.
- **Historical present** (informal storytelling): *So he **says** to me, "Where's the money?"*
Idiom: *Well, she **would say** that, wouldn't she?* — Her words are exactly what we expected (and not very convincing).

## Common mistakes
- ~~She said me that she was late.~~ → She **told me** (that) she was late.
- ~~He told that he was ill.~~ → He **told us** that he was ill.
- ~~I was said that the train was cancelled.~~ → I **was told** that...
- ~~Don't say lies. / He said the truth.~~ → Don't **tell** lies. / He **told** the truth.
- ~~The label tells to keep it cold.~~ → The label **says** to keep it cold.
structure:
## Say и tell
| | say | tell |
|---|---|---|
| адресат | не нужен (или **to** + лицо) | обязателен (без to) |
| that-clause | She **said** (that) she was late. | She **told me** (that) she was late. |
| приказ | He **said** to wait. (разг.) | He **told me** to wait. |
| фиксированные фразы | say hello / sorry / thanks / a prayer | tell the truth / a lie / a story / a joke / the time / the difference |
| тексты, знаки | The sign **says**... | — |

## Время вводного глагола
| Время | Когда | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| said / told | прошлое сообщение, сдвиг времён | She **told** me it **was** ready. |
| says / tells | актуально, газеты, тексты | The forecast **says** it will rain. |
| has said / has told | недавно, важно сейчас | He's **told** everyone. |
| was saying / was telling | прервано, смягчение | I **was just telling** Ruth... |
| will tell / will say | будущее | I'll **tell** him. |
| was / has been told | пассив | I **was told** that... |

exercises.title: Say или tell?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужную форму глагола say или tell (время указано контекстом).

items.text: Nobody {{told}} me that the office was closed.
Please don't {{tell}} anyone about the surprise.
Can you {{tell}} the difference between these two photos?
I was {{told}} that the train would be late.
He always {{says}} he'll call back, but he never does.

exercises.title: Время вводного глагола
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужную форму вводного глагола (подсказка в скобках).

items.text: Right now the forecast {{says}} that it will rain tomorrow.
Look at this email! He {{has told|'s told}} everyone that I'm leaving.
I {{was telling}} Ruth about the plan when the phone rang.
Yesterday the manager {{said}} that the deadline had moved.
We {{have been told|'ve been told}} that the flight is delayed.
Well, she {{would}} say that, wouldn't she?
So he {{says}} to me, 'Where is the money?' (рассказ в настоящем)

items.q: She ___ me that she was moving abroad.
items.why: После **tell** нужно лицо: told me that.

items.q: He ___ hello to everyone in the room.
Can you ___ me the way to the station?
The notice ___ that the library closes at six.
I can't ___ them apart; the twins look identical.
She ___ to me that the results were encouraging.
He ___ the whole story from the beginning.
The doctor ___ him he should lose weight.
Ask Mia — she ___ me she knows the answer.
items.why: Важно сейчас — present perfect: **has told**; **say** перед лицом без to не употребляется.

items.q: 'Wait,' said Ben. 'I ___ Ana that we'd be late when you arrived.'
She ___ me that the contract was ready, so I went to sign it.
I ___ that the museum is closed on Mondays.
He ___ me last night that he'd quit.
So he ___ me he can't come, and I'm thinking, why not call earlier?
The report ___ that emissions rose by 4%.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя say или tell.

items.prompt: What did someone tell you today? Use: told me ...
items.sample: My neighbour told me that the lift would be repaired tomorrow.

items.prompt: What do you always say when you meet a friend?
items.sample: I always say hello with a big smile.

items.prompt: Say what a sign or a label near you says.
items.sample: The sign on my desk says 'Keep calm and carry on'.

items.prompt: Do you tell jokes? Describe one situation.
items.sample: I sometimes tell jokes to my colleagues at lunch.

items.prompt: Who tells you the news or the weather in the morning? Use: says ...
items.sample: The radio says it will be sunny this afternoon.
